subject.title: Memory dreaming run pegs the gateway event loop for ~10 min until killed; short-term recall store can never persist (2026.6.9, reproduces on unmodified dist)

question: Should maintainers require reporter samples or a live current-main/macOS reproduction before queueing a memory-core performance fix for this Dreaming hang?
rationale: The reported release regression is strong, but current main has substantial post-release memory-core changes and the exact hot path is not isolated enough for a conservative automated repair.

options.title: Collect sample and live repro first
options.body: Ask for the 6.11 sample or reproduce on a copied long-lived workspace shape, then queue a fix against the confirmed hot path.

options.title: Queue source-guided repair now
options.body: Start a bounded repair from the current state-store and promotion paths, accepting more risk that the patch targets the wrong final-stage work.

options.title: Track only crash recovery
options.body: Defer this issue to interrupted-run observability, which would improve diagnostics but would not by itself solve the event-loop peg.

recommendation.title: Collect sample and live repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for the 6.11 sample or reproduce on a copied long-lived workspace shape, then queue a fix against the confirmed hot path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle maps to the latest current-main memory-core state lines and is best positioned to judge whether the post-release state rewrite is intended to address this report.
